newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI BAHT RALLIES LATE ON RISING IMF HOPES.
newsitem.headline: THAI BAHT RALLIES LATE ON RISING IMF HOPES.

text.p: The Thai baht rallied against the dollar in late trade on Thursday on rising hopes about the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) rescue package, dealers said.

"The baht's sharp rise offshore helped boost the baht sentiment in local market. The only positive news I heard today is the near completion of IMF's rescue package," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht surged to 30.85/31.10 to the dollar late in the domestic market from 31.65/31.85 in early morning.
Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Thursday he would visit Japan on Sunday for talks with Japanese and IMF officials.
Thanong said on a radio programme he would finalise a $12-15 billion IMF-sponsored austerity package for Thailand during the Tokyo visit.
He said he expects the IMF board in Washington to approve the reform package by August 21 and the agency to sign the financial assisance programme with the Thai government later this month.
Dealers said the market also reacted positively to the news that Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh was preparing for an audience with King Bhumibol Adulyadej on Thursday evening.
Chavalit together with Thanong and central bank governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi were expected to receive advice from the king or give him a report on the economic situation.
"Local banks were selling dollars on speculation that there might be some positive news after the prime minister's meeting with the king," said another dealer.
In the offshore market, the baht rose to 30.80/31.00 in late trade from 31.20/30.40 in early morning.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 11/15 satangs per dollar late in domestic market and 20/30 satangs in offshore market.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 8.00-9.00 percent late from 12.00-13.00 early on rising liquidity after the passage of central bank's reserve requirement today, dealers said.
All commercial banks have to meet the central bank's reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of every month.
